messages:
Anita: Quick question — can we automatically bump Health Score when onboarding checklist completes? We keep losing points for 'pending enablement' even after CS marks kickoff done.
Jamal: +1, we had manual backfills last week. what's the current source of truth for the checklist?
Devon: it's in Gainsight (playbook events) + a webhook into our CRM. problem is the webhook sometimes drops the last 'enablement_complete' event.
Lia: ops-bot reported 3 webhook 500s on 03/02. I think the retries failed after 3 attempts.
ops-bot: [alert] webhook delivery failures for playbook-events -> crm-sync (3 errors)
Anita: Ok — proposal: add a durable retry + a one-off reconciliation job that looks for accounts with onboarding_status=completed in Gainsight but health_score < 60 and runs the same score adjust logic.
Jamal: Sounds good. Also want the reconciliation to capture a reason tag so renewals PMs can filter (e.g., reconciled:onboard_complete).
Devon: I can add a playbook webhook backoff and durable queue. For the recon job I'll need a mapping of checklist -> score delta. Lia, can you paste the current mapping?
Lia: here's the rough mapping we use now:
```
onboarding_kickoff: +10
training_complete: +20
usage_threshold_1: +15
enablement_complete: +25
```
We also subtract -15 for prolonged inactivity.
Anita: Perfect. For QA: can we simulate with a small batch (10 accounts) and verify token-level audit logs?
Devon: Yep. I'll create a feature branch and a dry-run mode that logs the intended changes without applying. Patch will expose an endpoint `/reconcile-onboard` that accepts JSON array of account ids.
Jamal: Can we add a guard to skip accounts with 'at_risk' tag so we don't auto-raise their score without human review?
Devon: Good call — add skip_if_tagged = ["at_risk", "legal_review"].
Lia: Also add a field in the audit payload: source: "reconcile_job_v1" and old_score/new_score + playbook_event ids.
Anita: Owner? timeline? We need this before the renewal QBR (2 weeks).
Devon: I'll own implementation and tests. Plan: PR in 3 days, staging run the following day, prod reconcile after signoff.
Jamal: I'll own the PM side — create a small dashboard for reconciled accounts and a weekly digest for renewals.
Lia: I'll patch the webhook retry config and follow up on the ops-bot alerts.
ops-bot: [info] scheduled webhook retry policy updated by Lia.
Anita: Awesome. One last ask — include a feedback capture checkbox so CS can mark "score contested" which preserves old score but flags it for review.
Devon: Will add boolean `contested` on the reconcile payload; if true, create a review task and don't mutate score.
Anita: Thanks team — please drop the PR link here when ready and ping #renewals for visibility. :pray:
